name: Review Card
description: A type-only client review on a plain tone background: small capitals eyebrow, stars, a large italic quote, then a short rule, the client's name, a detail line and an italic signature.
bestFor: the words slide after a photo slide in a carousel

tones.note: All six tones work. Balsam and sienna use light text.

fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.hint: Optional small capitals line at the top.

fields.label: Quote
fields.hint: Their words. Shrinks to fit; up to about 260 characters.

fields.label: Signature
fields.hint: Optional italic sign-off on the right. Not for social handles.

sample.quote: She made our nervous family feel like the most photogenic people alive.
sample.name: The Alvarez family
